title: Michael Shayne
paragraphs: Radio adventures featuring Brett Halliday's private detective Michael Shayne, following the tough investigator through murder, blackmail, disappearances, and other criminal cases across several radio productions.

Mixed-incarnation Michael Shayne radio archive. The frozen GRH snapshot combines two late Wally Maher Mutual programs, thirty Jeff Chandler syndicated-package recordings/copies, and one 1953 Vinton Hayworth ABC program. Dates and numbering are interpreted within each production layer, not as one continuous series sequence.

GRH documents the program through Mutual / Wally Maher incarnation (October 16, 1944 to November 14, 1947) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], Jeff Chandler Broadcasters Guild syndication (1948), and ABC revival (October 14, 1952 to July 10, 1953) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are William P. Rousseau (director on 31 recordings), Don W. Sharpe (producer on 30 recordings), [[person|jeff-chandler|Jeff Chandler]] (performer on 30 recordings), John Duffy (music on 30 recordings, composer on 1 recording, and conductor on 1 recording), Brett Halliday (creator on 2 recordings), Cathy Lewis (performer on 2 recordings), and Wally Maher (performer on 2 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by), [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]] (syndicated by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include private detective investigation, hard-boiled/noir crime atmosphere, New Orleans setting in the Jeff Chandler incarnation, murder and homicide, blackmail, fraud and coercion, and guns, violence and physical clues.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Popular literary detective franchise moves through radio incarnations, Postwar transcribed detective syndication, Postwar hard-boiled crime and noir radio, and Network-to-syndication-to-network production shifts.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (5 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (5 shared credited people), [[show|suspense|Suspense]] (5 shared credited people), [[show|jeff-regan-investigator|Jeff Regan, Investigator]] (3 shared credited people), and [[show|let-george-do-it|Let George Do It]] (3 shared credited people).
